papers.what_it_is: A 2000 preprint that generalizes Grover's search to amplitude amplification, introduces amplitude estimation via phase estimation of the Grover iterate, and derives quantum counting algorithms with matching lower bounds.

was restricted to producing an equal superposition of all members
of X and we had a promise that a single x existed such that χ(x) = 1.
